name: crispy
description: Project structure visualization & Working with AI agents

crispy.codexCliPath.markdownDescription: Optional Codex CLI executable path. When empty, Windows tries `codex`, `codex.cmd`, and `codex.exe` in order.

crispy.claudeCliPath.markdownDescription: Optional Claude CLI executable path. When empty, Windows tries `claude`, `claude.cmd`, and `claude.exe` in order.

crispy.antigravityCliPath.markdownDescription: Optional Antigravity CLI executable path. When empty, Windows tries `agy`, `agy.cmd`, and `agy.exe` in order.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: pnpm run package && pnpm run stage:node-pty && pnpm run verify:node-pty
scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
scripts.test:process-tree-cleanup: pnpm run compile-tests && node out/test/agent/processTreeCleanup.test.js && node out/test/agent/processTreeControllerFactory.test.js
